## 1. Prediction market

In the [Polymarket winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), confirmed reading of October 4, 18:59 BRT, with the count under way, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 18.95pp, to 83.50% (USD 15.71M), and Lula falls 20.00pp, to 15.50% (USD 16.00M), against the confirmed reading of October 3, 20:23 BRT. The gap goes from 29.05pp to 68.00pp, and the move normalized by the pair sum is 19.83pp to each side. Total accumulated volume in the presidential book adds up to USD 168.86M across 19 contracts, with USD 5.03M of new money since the reading of October 3. This edition keeps the last confirmed reading of the winner contract, the one of 18:59.

Flávio Bolsonaro stands 20.20pp above the recorded top of the series since April 14, 63.30% on October 1, and Lula 19.00pp below the recorded floor, 34.50% on April 25. The Renan Santos contract stands at 0.05% and remains the one with the largest accumulated volume in the presidential book, USD 17.10M.

In the confirmed reading of 20:59, the [second place book](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place) paid 99.65% (USD 2.26M) for Lula finishing the first round in second, and the [third place one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), 99.50% (USD 0.54M) for Augusto Cury in third, the same order as the TSE result. The [Supreme Court impeachment contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stands at 2.60% (USD 0.09M).

## 2. What the polling firms registered

In the official TSE partial count of 20:58 BRT, with 97.65% of polling sections tallied and turnout of 78.95% in them, Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.39% of valid votes, Lula 44.74%, Augusto Cury 2.91%, Ronaldo Caiado 2.21% and Renan Santos 2.26%. The TSE marked the result as mathematically defined: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula go to the second round, [scheduled for October 25](https://news.google.?oc=5).

In the nine national polls released on October 3, the eve of the vote, Lula was ahead in the first round in five and Flávio Bolsonaro in four. AtlasIntel put [Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 44.1% of valid votes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNRjVZblgycmpOcmgwQ3hOX3ZPY2h1b0tQejMwM1JzTTdOLWdpaE05RVhYZENqbEQ0Qm1idi1xUWJKZGR6bndTTDU2dlgxVlM5TTAtR2MzRVJld3l5eHNZUUhpcnRNWWJXN0ZYc1o2eUNES1RobWVrYmUzUXgxcTZsUE5DSW1hQlVkblNUclBKRTNlb2RJWmd4bkIwZ0JMSjlFeU14US16MENMaGMxeG0wNnN1Wm4?oc=5), and Gerp's second round of the day put [Flávio Bolsonaro at 44% and Lula at 42%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNM1lianAtblUxZUppc043ZmtNSmt6NHBmTjhVakkzcTlCaFpEOUszYTFuWkxmbDZnZW9LbG1jUkFyYXgxWllyelJPSTFaeTd4QjlfQVQyYmFjRGlITlVUTG9QQ3dCc2FSRFdwNjZpZjFxUTBMZEJ0MkR4elpsOHh0a3R4WUhsVzBvOGV6T1RJeEJoWHp3UElFag?oc=5). On the eve, the largest margin in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro was 4 points, in Palver, and the largest in favor of Lula, 5.7 points in valid votes in CNT/MDA.

## 3. What the press covered

With more than 90% of ballot boxes counted, O Globo began publishing the [Datafolha projections for the second round](https://news.google.?oc=5). Flávio Bolsonaro [arrived at the campaign headquarters to follow the count alongside allies](https://valor.globo.com/noticia/2026/10/04/flvio-chega-a-qg-da-campanha-para-acompanhar-apurao-ao-lado-de-aliados.ghtml), and, according to Folha de S.Paulo, his campaign [is seeking the support of top vote getters and growth in Minas Gerais in a possible second round](https://news.google.?oc=5).

In the states, Tarcísio de Freitas [defeated Fernando Haddad in the first round and was reelected governor of São Paulo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/10/04/tarcisio-vence-haddad-no-primeiro-turno-e-vai-governar-sao-paulo-por-mais-quatro-anos.ghtml), a result that [Brasil de Fato reported based on the Datafolha projection](https://news.google.?oc=5). In Santa Catarina, [Carol de Toni and Carlos Bolsonaro were elected to the Senate](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-eleicoes-2026/carol-de-toni-e-carlos-bolsonaro-sao-eleitos-ao-senado-por-santa-catarina/), and in Paraná [Sergio Moro was elected governor in the first round](https://news.google.?oc=5). In the Federal District, [Celina Leão and Leandro Grass will face off in the second round](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/eleicoes/celina-leao-pp-e-leandro-grass-pt-vao-disputar-segundo-turno-no-distrito-federal/), [as also reported by O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/10/04/celina-leao-e-leandro-grass-vao-disputar-segundo-turno-pelo-governo-do-distrito-federal.ghtml).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Partial count x poll:** in the TSE partial count of 20:58, with 97.65% of polling sections, Flávio Bolsonaro had a 2.65 point lead in valid votes, within the range of the nine national polls of the eve, which went from 5.7 points for Lula, in CNT/MDA, to 4 points for him, in Palver.

> **Market x poll:** five of the nine national polls of the eve put Lula ahead in the first round, and at 18:59 the winner contract paid 83.50% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

> **Abroad x Brazil:** outside the country Lula led in more countries and had more votes, [according to Poder360](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxOdXAtMmVOcDFwOGN2cHJfMjQxUmFFRm1xMnFqNHJDV1hlLUY4UkRCR21jd0pNaGd2bktlODhOWGQyLS0zTHNLVGFMUDF0dHVWc0d5bzktcWx2RFZYWlppWmJhYUZ3MUVNMTBOdUpyN3Nvc0JVelY0TllaNzFxcjlVTTVBN3BYaUZMM2c?oc=5), and in the national partial count Flávio Bolsonaro was ahead.

## In summary

**The winner contract paid 83.50% for Flávio Bolsonaro at 18:59.** The gap went from 29.05pp to 68.00pp since the reading of October 3.

**The 20:58 partial count showed a larger margin than the polls.** Flávio Bolsonaro had 47.39% of valid votes with 97.65% of polling sections tallied.

**There will be a second round.** Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula face off on October 25, and four national polls are already registered for October 8 and 9.
